brand.name: Northline RP
brand.tagline: Northbound RP community portal for s&box

home.headline: Your city portal for Northbound RP.
home.subheadline: Check the server, follow the city, manage your citizen profile, and stay connected outside s&box.
home.intro: Northline RP is a community server running Northbound RP, the ApeTavern / aperp gamemode for s&box. Steam sign-in links the portal to your in-game save without replacing the game as the source of truth.

content.announcementTitle: Built for the city, not just the homepage
content.announcementBody: The portal is designed around player profiles, city activity, onboarding, transparent operations, and staff tools that can expand safely over time.
content.footerText: Northline RP is a community server project running Northbound RP for s&box. Not affiliated with Valve, Steam, Facepunch, Garry's Mod, ApeTavern, or Northbound RP unless otherwise stated.
content.earlyAccessBody: Server systems, balance values, website pages, and profile data may change while Northline RP is being built. The game server remains the source of truth.

features.title: Citizen identity
features.body: Steam sign-in connects your account to your Northline save, public profile, titles, stats, and property summaries.

features.title: City pulse
features.body: Live server status, Tweeter posts, population activity, and staff notices keep the community informed.

features.title: Expandable foundation
features.body: The portal is built to support future bridge-backed features and cosmetic supporter perks without pay-to-win rewards.

privacySections.title: Steam-linked identity
privacySections.body: The portal uses Steam OpenID to confirm SteamID64 and may use public Steam profile name/avatar information for account display.

privacySections.title: Portal and server data
privacySections.body: The portal may read or store citizen profiles, profile settings, public posts, messages, applications, Discord-link status, moderation records, audit logs, connection history, and server status data.

privacySections.title: Public visibility
privacySections.body: Public pages are intentionally limited. Sensitive gameplay details, private messages, staff notes, moderation evidence, secrets, webhook URLs, API keys, and exploit-useful information should not be public.

privacySections.title: Moderation and retention
privacySections.body: Staff may retain and review records needed for safety, rule enforcement, appeals, audit integrity, server security, backups, or abuse prevention.

termsSections.title: Community portal
termsSections.body: Northline RP provides this website as a companion portal for the Northbound RP / ApeTavern / aperp s&box server.

termsSections.title: Acceptable use
termsSections.body: Do not harass, impersonate, spam, evade moderation, exploit bugs, scrape restricted data, attack the service, or misuse account/staff features.

termsSections.title: Moderation and access
termsSections.body: Staff may remove content, restrict features, hide profiles, ban accounts, revoke permissions, or disable staff page access when needed to protect the server.

termsSections.title: No pay-to-win
termsSections.body: Future supporter perks should remain cosmetic, convenience-based, or community-facing and must not provide gameplay power or moderation preference.
